import numpy as np
base=[np.ones_like(t),np.sqrt(t),t/x,x**3,t,1/t]
best=None
for w in np.linspace(0.2,6,300):
    A=np.column_stack(base+[np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    n=np.mean((A@c-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
    if best is None or n<best[0]: best=(n,w,c)
